_description: Respawn points (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Spawning#Respawn_point): each point's tile is the centre of the Wiki's respawn area; Lumbridge is the world's own spawn. `requires` is checked whenever an NPC sets the point. NPC lines are their generated transcripts' own (npc-dialogues.json).
_places: the place names in the NPCs' 'If the player's respawn point is (not) ...:' conditions
_setters: per NPC: a line ('line', set as it shows), an action step ('action') or a menu option ('choice' under 'prompt', set as it is picked) that sets `point`; `pay` takes the unlock fee from the inventory and unlocks it; `from` limits the line to a player whose point is that one
